name: Mustafa Mahmoud Younis
title: Senior Mobile Engineer
headline: I build and ship Flutter apps that real businesses run on — POS systems, CRMs and real-estate platforms used by hundreds of thousands of people.
availability: Open to senior Flutter roles · Remote or Cairo
summary: Senior mobile engineer with 5+ years of experience building cross-platform products in Flutter. I've taken apps from early concept to production and kept improving them after launch, across POS systems, CRM tools, real-estate platforms and service apps. Today I lead mobile development at The Address Investments, where I own the shared architecture behind several store apps and mentor the team that builds on it. I care most about scalable architecture, fast and reliable apps, and a user experience that feels effortless.

education.degree: Bachelor Degree, Systems and Computers Engineering

highlights: Lead mobile development across the company's store apps: Address Circle (10K+ downloads, 5★ on the App Store), My TAI (5K+ downloads, 4.5★ from 50+ ratings) and The MarQ.
Designed the shared Flutter base project the apps are built on: Clean Architecture, BLoC, dependency injection with get_it/injectable, go_router, Dio networking and a reusable widget library.
Integrated Firebase messaging, analytics and remote config, deep links, biometric login and in-app updates, keeping releases on iOS and Android consistent.
Published customized_country_phone_picker on pub.dev (160 pub points), an EN/AR phone input now used in the company apps.
Lead technical decisions, review code and mentor the mobile team.
Built a customized POS system for restaurants and markets that reduced order processing time by 50% and increased client sales by 20%.
Implemented real-time sales tracking and inventory features over Socket IO, reducing waste by 25%.
Developed reusable Flutter packages and native plugins for payment integrations and receipt printing, shared across projects.
Shipped one Flutter codebase to four stores: App Store, Google Play, Huawei AppGallery and Microsoft Store.
Built the KSA E-Invoice QR Reader, which grew to 250K+ active users.

projects.name: Snapos
projects.description: Cloud POS for restaurants and retail, running on phones, tablets and Windows terminals. Cut order processing time by 50%.
highlights: Problem: restaurant staff needed one fast POS that works on the hardware they already own, from Android tablets to Windows counters.
My role: Flutter developer on the core app, from ordering flow to payments and cloud item management.
Hard part: keeping orders, sales and inventory in sync in real time over Socket IO across four platforms from one codebase.
Result: order processing time down 50%, client sales up 20%, shipped on App Store, Google Play, Huawei AppGallery and Microsoft Store.

projects.name: Address Circle
projects.description: Real-estate platform that connects brokers and agents with The Address Investments' projects, with faster earning cycles and rewards. 10K+ downloads, 5★ on the App Store.
highlights: Problem: brokers had no single place to find exclusive projects, submit leads and track their earnings.
My role: lead Flutter engineer, owning architecture, delivery and releases.
Hard part: a modular Clean Architecture + BLoC codebase with deep links, push notifications, remote config, biometric login and document scanning, all kept fast with skeleton loading and pagination.
Result: 10K+ downloads on Google Play and a 5★ App Store rating.

projects.name: My TAI
projects.description: CRM and employee app for The Address Investments' 2,500+ staff: leads, customers, vacancies and real-time updates. 5K+ downloads, 4.5★ from 50+ ratings.
highlights: Problem: sales teams needed the full CRM in their pocket, not only on the desktop.
My role: senior Flutter engineer maintaining and extending the app.
Hard part: real-time updates over Socket IO, offline caching with Hive, charts and maps on large datasets.
Result: 5K+ downloads and a 4.5★ App Store rating from 50+ ratings.
